title: Ideal-sheaf conormal comparison and stalk rank for a smooth closed diagonal
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], smooth of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], whose diagonal $i:X\to P=X\times_S X$ [def-pc-base-change] is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $\mathcal I=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{toModules}$ be the module sheaf attached to the ideal of this closed immersion [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $C=i^*\mathcal I$ its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $\Omega=\Omega^1_{X/S}$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. Then $C\cong\Omega$ as module sheaves, and for every $x\in X$ the module stalk $C_x$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] has $\mathrm{Module.finrank}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(C_x)=d$. The finrank is the natural number associated to the rank of this finite free stalk module.

proof.text: Construct the morphism from i.ker.toModules to the actual module-sheaf kernel by kernel.lift. The factorization i.toImage ≫ i.imageι = i makes its composite zero on every open. On every affine open, ker_apply and range_toModulesι_app identify the two ranges inside the structure ring. Injectivity of the kernel inclusion makes the lift bijective on those sections. The affine-basis isomorphism criterion gives an isomorphism; tensorPullback.mapIso then identifies C with diagonalConormal f.
Compose this comparison with diagonalConormal_iso_relativeDifferentials to obtain C isomorphic to Omega.

Apply isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_relativeDifferentials to Omega, and lem-sc-finite-locally-free-stalk-finrank to compute each of its stalk finranks. The isomorphism of step 2 is mapped by moduleStalkFunctor to a module isomorphism. Convert it to a linear equivalence and use LinearEquiv.finrank_eq to transport that equality to C.

mathlib_searches.query: For a smooth scheme morphism of pure relative dimension d the diagonal conormal formed from the kernel ideal sheaf is isomorphic to relative differentials and has stalk finrank d
The diagonal conormal formed from the ideal sheaf of a closed smooth diagonal is relative differentials and its stalk finrank is the relative dimension

lean.statement: theorem smoothDiagonal_idealConormal_iso_and_rank {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [IsClosedImmersion (pullback.diagonal f)] : Nonempty (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.diagonal f)).obj (pullback.diagonal f).ker.toModules) ≅ f.relativeDifferentials) ∧ ∀ x : X, Module.finrank (X.presheaf.stalk x) ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.diagonal f)).obj (pullback.diagonal f).ker.toModules)) = d
